why: Shared: R_λ = rank H_λ (B's first clause holds outright by Module.finrank_eq_rank; the project's bettiNumber is finrank of spaceHomology). A gives homeomorphism invariance of Betti numbers, H_*(E,∅) = H_*(E), and an abstract slab lemma: given the hypothesis CellAttachHomology, the finrank of embedded cells in a Hausdorff space, plus the three strong deformation retractions of Theorems 3.1/3.2, dim H_i(X,A) = #cells of dimension i. B asserts, for Milnor's filtration of a compact manifold (one critical point per slab), an isomorphism H_n(M^{a_{i+1}}, M^{a_i}) ≅ H_n(M^{a_i} ∪_g e^λ, M^{a_i}) with an abstract quotient adjunction space for some attaching map g. A ⇒ B fails genuinely. A says nothing about manifolds or sublevel sets. The project's manifold slab computation (sublevel_step) gives only dimensions, and nothing in the project computes the homology of a quotient attachment Y ∪_g e (the project works with embedded cells). B ⇒ A fails: B has no homeomorphism invariance and no abstract SDR/cell lemma.
